terms.title: Amategeko n'Amahame ya Umuryango
terms.subtitle: Soma uko Umuryango urinda inyandiko n'imicungire y'umutungo w'umuryango.
terms.section1_body: Buri musanzu, ikiguzi, ubwishyu, n'umushinga w'umuryango bibikwa mu rubuga rw'umuryango wawe bigaragaza uwabikoze.
terms.section2_body: Amafaranga abikwa neza mu mibare yuzuye hamwe n'amateka agaragarira buri munyamuryango wemerewe.
terms.section3_title: 3. Gukora nta murandasi no guhuza mutekanye
terms.section3_body: Ibikorwa byanditswe nta murandasi bibikwa kuri telefone cyangwa mudasobwa bikazoherezwa hatabayeho gusubiramo inyandiko.
terms.section4_body: Umunyamuryango yemera kurinda ijambo ry'ibanga cyangwa PIN ye no kubaha uburenganzira bushyirwaho n'umuyobozi w'umuryango.
family_setup.title: Tunganya umuryango wawe
family_setup.subtitle: Hitamo uko ushaka gutangira gucunga umutungo w'umuryango wawe muri Umuryango.
family_setup.create_desc: Fungura urubuga rushya rw'umuryango maze utumire abagize urugo.
family_setup.join_desc: Injira mu rubuga rw'umuryango rusanzwe ukoresheje ubutumire bw'umuyobozi w'umuryango.
family_setup.selected_create: wahisemo gutangiza umuryango. Urubuga rushya rw'umuryango wawe rugiye gutunganywa.
family_setup.selected_join: Wahisemo kwinjira mu muryango. Shyiramo ubutumire bw'umuryango wawe.
family_setup.selected_skip: Wasimbutse gutunganya umuryango ubu. Ushobora kuwutangiza cyangwa kwinjiramo nyuma.
